items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Joe Cohn is a great guitar player

ctx.x: Well I mean if you’re talking about in the range of all the instruments there are a lot of guys. Bill Charlap, wonderful, wonderful piano player; Russell Malone, a great guitar
player; Joe Cohn is a great guitar player; Larry Goldings is a great piano player; Chris Potter is a wonderful saxophone player.
Now there’s a guy that started out pretty young too, didn’t he?
